title: $1,000 in Ethereum in 2017 is now worth this
caption:
In 2017, Ethereum was a new crypto network.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:ETH-USD:2017-11-09} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Ethereum in 2017? 👇
sources: Ethereum price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 2017, Ethereum was a new crypto network.
Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:ETH-USD:2017-11-09}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
